test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Cut corners

options.text: Do something in an inexpensive and easy way

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Do something in an inexpensive and easy way. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Cut corners"** means to do something in the easiest, cheapest, or fastest way. (किसी काम को आसान, सस्ता, या सबसे तेज़ तरीके से करना) • **Example: **The contractor cut corners by using low-quality materials, which caused the building to collapse. • **"Cut corners"** refers to avoiding steps that are necessary or skipping important details to save time or money. (समय या पैसे बचाने के लिए आवश्यक कामों को छोड़ना) • **Example: **When you cut corners on safety, you put everyone at risk. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Do something in an inexpensive and easy way. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Complete a work **(काम पूरा करना): To finish a task or project. • **Example:** She managed to complete the work before the deadline. • **Find a suitable place **(उचित स्थान खोजें): To locate an appropriate location for something. • **Example: **They need to find a suitable place for the new office. • **Clear a space** (जगह साफ़ करना): To remove obstacles or clutter from an area. • **Example:** We need to clear a space in the garage for the new car. 3a:Tcb9, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Enthusiastic.
